messages:
Josh: quick ping — opened a small PR to align the Elixir SDK retry/backoff behavior with our Ruby client, would love a quick look
Priya: link?
Josh: https://github.com/redwood-inference/elixir-sdk/pull/42 — summary: unify default max_retries, add jittered exponential backoff, and ensure 401 triggers token refresh + single retry after refresh
Anya: :eyes: I'll skim now
Tom: CI matrix got a macOS SSL flake on the first run, fwiw
CI-Bot: build #123 failed on macOS-latest — openssl: certificate verify failed (log excerpt: "SSL_connect returned=1 errno=0 state=error: certificate verify failed")
Josh: I rebased and pushed an ssl-probe fix, re-running CI (was an ephemeral runner cert issue)
Priya: code looks pretty consistent with the ruby impl. One nit: Ruby default is max_retries=3, this PR sets 4. Intentionally different?
Josh: ah thanks — I meant to keep parity. Setting to 3 now and force-pushing
Anya: tiny docs suggestion: add a short example showing how to wire a token refresh callback for streaming/generative requests — people always ask about that
Josh: good call, added README snippet in the PR. Example: 
```elixir
# tiny token provider example
defmodule TokenProvider do
  def get_token do
    case OAuth.refresh_if_needed() do
      {:ok, token} -> token
      {:error, _} -> raise "token refresh failed"
    end
  end
end
client = Redwood.Client.new(token_provider: &TokenProvider.get_token/0)
```
Tom: can we also add an integration test that simulates a 401 and verifies the client invokes the token_provider and retries exactly once after refresh? Minimal test in test/retry_test.exs should be fine
Josh: yep I'll add a test that stubs the HTTP client to return 401 once then 200 after refresh
Priya: once test + change to default max_retries=3 and the macOS CI flake is green, I'm happy to approve
Tom: curious: did you keep the jitter seed deterministic for tests? Ruby has deterministic jitter in tests to avoid flakiness
Josh: I added an option to inject a jitter_fn for testing, default uses :rand.uniform but tests pass a fixed fn. Added note in test helper
Anya: nice. Also added a doc inline for "how this interacts with auto-batching" — might save support tickets
Josh: thanks all, pushing the test now and will ping when CI finishes
CI-Bot: build #124 queued
